chain.action: append a full registration request to the loopback origin with an exact content length, then a trailing request fragment so the second request is closed
chain.why: the backend calls itself, so the loopback restriction is satisfied

chain.action: carry an upsert payload in the registration password so the existing privileged row's password is replaced instead of inserting a duplicate

chain.action: log in as the privileged account with the password just set

first_confirming_probe.request: put a harmless marker with one folded space character into the interpolated field and compare the error with an ordinary hostname
first_confirming_probe.expected: the parser accepts the folded character, showing the field is not encoded
first_confirming_probe.falsifier: the field is encoded or validated, so no control characters survive
